build_contract: Same source, LLVM22.1.8, Release O2, jemalloc, recorded CMake options byte-identical. Only applyFunctionOverRange.cpp changes. No R32/R34 or JOIN patch.

fixture.layout: RAW_UUID TimeSeries v11, same frozen physical tables for all phases
fixture.notes: Synthetic build-coherent fixture, not a production export. One sample per distinct series. Project/branch/job are build-level labels. Range bounds and the first left-boundary sample are handled by the independent oracle.

query_shape: avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(ci_duration{selector}[1d])) via native prometheusQueryRange over 14 daily timestamps
protocol: stock/candidate/candidate/stock, fresh server per phase, two warmups plus two measured requests per selector per phase. Complete labels/timestamps/values checked on every response against an independent Python fixture oracle, tolerance 1e-10. Exact user part census unchanged. All QueryFinish records captured.
reporting: Values are means of the two within-phase medians. RSS is the mean of within-phase medians of sampled request RSS peaks, not a kernel high-water guarantee. The sample count does not establish p95/p99.

whole_metric.interpretation: Native CPU/state reduction with unchanged physical read volume, not an index/selectivity or cache improvement. Read rows count all inner read paths, not just logical samples.

stage.decision: Memory reduction observed; latency effect smaller than candidate control drift, so INCONCLUSIVE for latency.

project.decision: Memory reduction observed; latency direction favorable but substantial stock drift and few samples require replication.

dense_control.protocol: Fresh-server stock/candidate/candidate/stock; two warmups plus six measurements per phase; independent analytic slope oracle; all outputs and physical parts equal.
dense_control.notes: Dense query memory is almost unchanged; do not extrapolate sparse memory savings. RSS varies strongly between phases and is not accepted as a dense RSS win.

limitations: No production workload, retention/read-write stress, tenant/ACL gate, distributed path, or optimized VM comparison. No combined R34+R35 claim. Earlier local long commands were killed by the execution harness; recovered logs are preserved as invalid/censored, not OOM or measured speedups. Final large ABBA used detached local execution during the same interactive session and completed all four phases.
next_experiment: Two simultaneous broad native requests under the same finite memory cap, retaining failed requests and complete query logs.
